How fast a fix reaches you

  • Within hours, without a store review: new ad and tracker domains, CSS selectors for ad boxes and the names of YouTube's ad fields. They travel in the signed filter data, which reaches every installation about twice a day.
  • With a new version: anything that is code, such as a new anti-adblock routine or a change to how blocking works. A new version goes through the store's review, so we cannot promise a time.

Something broken now? Support has the one-click fixes, and the extension's Site broken? page tells us which site.
